summary: Shows the split filter converting a delimited string into a list, e.g. splitting 'apple,banana,orange' by commas.
questions: How do I split a comma-separated string into a list in Ansible?
How do I loop over a delimited string?

answer_card.title: Splitting strings into lists
answer_card.answer_md:
```jinja
{{ fruits | split(',') }}
```

Turns `fruits: apple,banana,orange` into `[apple, banana, orange]`, ready for looping.
